findings.description: The reused supervisor attempted a signal after the owned child had been reaped and a post-wait error occurred. Reviewer intercepted the signal; no unrelated process was signaled. Selector construction also preceded ownership cleanup.
findings.next_fix: Owned artifact-only supervisor; signal only while child.returncode is None, own selector creation and all pipe cleanup.
